title: Pov: You Have 15 Minutes to Make Lunch : Quesadilla with Leftover Chicken
caption:
POV: you have 15 minutes to make lunch : Quesadilla with Leftover Chicken

Nutrition: 
C: 44 | F: 14 | P: 24
Calories: 379 per serve 
Serves 1

Ingredients
1 Tortilla Wrap 
1/2 tsp oil
1 tbsp minced garlic 
1/2 capsicum, sliced 
( any veges you want to saute and add work well here ) 
60 grams leftover chicken, I used leftover airfryer crispy chicken
20 grams mozarella cheese

serves great with a side salad and salsa + sour cream 

[ lunch, quick recipe, leftover chicken , any leftover meal , macros, Mexican fusion, quesadilla ]
